description: Returns transaction details for a confirmed transaction.

parameters.name: tx_sig
parameters.description: The transaction signature as base-58 encoded string

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: finalized
sub_parameters.description: The node will query the most recent block confirmed by the supermajority of the cluster as having reached maximum lockout, meaning the cluster has recognized this block as finalized

sub_parameters.name: confirmed
sub_parameters.description: The node will query the most recent block that has been voted on by the supermajority of the cluster

sub_parameters.name: maxSupportedTransactionVersion
sub_parameters.description: The maximum transaction version to return in responses. If the requested block contains a transaction with a higher version, an error will be returned. If this parameter is omitted, only legacy transactions will be returned, and a block containing any versioned transaction will prompt an error

sub_parameters.name: encoding
sub_parameters.description: (Default: json) The encoding format for the transaction data. It can be one of json, jsonParsed, base58, or base64

result.description: Null if the specified block is not confirmed otherwise RpcResponse JSON object with the following fields:

result.blockTime.description: The estimated production time, as Unix timestamp (seconds since the Unix epoch). It's null if not available

result.meta.description: The transaction status metadata object, which contains additional information about the block and its transactions. The meta object can be null, or it may contain the following fields:

result.meta.err.description: Error code if the transaction failed or null if the transaction succeeds

result.meta.fee.description: The total fees paid by all transactions in the block encoded as u64 integer

result.meta.innerInstructions.description: An array of objects representing the inner instructions of all transactions in the block (omitted if inner instruction recording is not enabled). Each object has the following fields:

result.meta.innerInstructions.index.description: The index of the instruction in the transaction, which determines the order in which the operations were executed

result.meta.innerInstructions.instructio.description: An array of instructions that were executed in the block's transactions
An array of parsed instructions that were executed in the block's transactions
An array of information objects that provide additional details about the transactions in the block
The number of lamports assigned to this account as u64 (64-bit unsigned integer)
The new account created as part of the transaction
The base-58 encoded Pubkey of the program this account has been assigned to
The source account that funded the transaction
The amount of storage space required to store a specific transaction
The type of the block. It can be used to differentiate between regular blocks and special blocks such as snapshot or transaction confirmation blocks
The data associated with the program that was executed in the block's transactions
The ID of the program that executed the instruction
The current depth of the execution stack

result.meta.logMessages.description: An array of strings containing any log messages generated by the block's transactions (omitted if inner instruction recording is not enabled)

result.meta.postBalances.description: An array of lamport balances for each account in the block after the transactions were processed

result.meta.postTokenBalances.description: An array of token balances for each token account in the block after the transactions were processed (omitted if inner instruction recording is not enabled)

result.meta.postTokenBalances.accountInd.description: The index of an account within a transaction

result.meta.postTokenBalances.mint.description: Provides information about the creation of new tokens

result.meta.postTokenBalances.owner.description: The authority pubkey for the token account. Can be a normal wallet or a program-derived address (PDA) used by protocols like escrows, vaults, pools, etc

result.meta.postTokenBalances.uiTokenAmo.description: The amount of a token transfer in a human-readable format
The amount of a token transfer
The number of decimal places used by the token
The amount of a token transfer in the smallest unit of the token
The amount of a token transfer as a string with the appropriate number of decimal places for the token

result.meta.preBalances.description: An array of lamport balances for each account in the block before the transactions were processed

result.meta.preTokenBalances.description: An array of token balances for each token account in the block before the transactions were processed (omitted if inner instruction recording is not enabled)

result.meta.preTokenBalances.accountInde.description: The index of an account within a transaction

result.meta.preTokenBalances.mint.description: Provides information about the creation of new tokens

result.meta.preTokenBalances.owner.description: The authority pubkey for the token account. Can be a normal wallet or a program-derived address (PDA) used by protocols like escrows, vaults, pools, etc

result.meta.preTokenBalances.uiTokenAmou.description: The amount of a token transfer in a human-readable format
The amount of a token transfer
The number of decimal places used by the token
The amount of a token transfer in the smallest unit of the token
The amount of a token transfer as a string with the appropriate number of decimal places for the token

result.meta.rewards.description: An object containing information about the rewards earned by the block's validators (only present if the rewards are requested). It has the following fields:

result.meta.status.description: The status of the transaction. If the transaction was successful, returns Ok and if the transaction failed with TransactionError, returns Err

result.slot.description: The slot number to retrieve block production information

result.transaction.description: The transaction object. It could be either JSON format or encoded binary data, depending on the encoding parameter

result.transaction.message.description: An array of transactions included in the block

result.transaction.message.accountKeys.description: An array of public keys associated with the accounts that were accessed during the execution of transactions in the block

result.transaction.message.accountKeys.p.description: The Pubkey of program encoded as base-58 string

result.transaction.message.accountKeys.s.description: Used to sign transactions in the block. Also used to identify the signers involved in the block's transactions and to verify the authenticity of the signatures
The source account that funded the transaction

result.transaction.message.accountKeys.w.description: A boolean value that indicates whether the accounts associated with the given public keys were modified by the transactions or not

result.transaction.message.instructions.description: An array of instructions that were executed in the block's transactions

result.transaction.message.instructions..description: An array of parsed instructions that were executed in the block's transactions
An array of information objects that provide additional details about the transactions in the block
An address on the Solana blockchain that is used to store assets
Provides information about the creation of new tokens
The source account that funded the transaction
The system program that executed the transaction
Responsible for maintaining the supply and balance of the token, and for executing transfers of the token between accounts
Wallet is used for managing and storing assets
The type of the block. It can be used to differentiate between regular blocks and special blocks such as snapshot or transaction confirmation blocks
The data associated with the program that was executed in the block's transactions
The ID of the program that executed the instruction

result.transaction.message.recentBlockha.description: The recent block hash for the account's cluster

result.transaction.signatures.description: The list of transaction signatures contained within a particular block

result.version.description: The transaction version. It's undefined if maxSupportedTransactionVersion is not set in the requested parameters
